scripts.dev:mock: pnpm exec varlock run -- env LLM_PROVIDER=mock pnpm dev:apps
scripts.dev:apps: pnpm --filter @nova/shared build && pnpm --filter @nova/model-runtime build && pnpm --parallel --filter @nova/web --filter @nova/api dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @nova/shared build && pnpm --filter @nova/model-runtime build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @nova/shared build && pnpm --filter @nova/model-runtime build && pnpm --filter @nova/api test
scripts.langfuse:prompts:sync: pnpm --filter @nova/shared build && pnpm --filter @nova/model-runtime build && pnpm --filter @nova/api build && varlock run -- node ops/langfuse/sync-prompts.mjs
scripts.langfuse:prompts:publish: pnpm --filter @nova/shared build && pnpm --filter @nova/model-runtime build && pnpm --filter @nova/api build && varlock run -- node ops/langfuse/sync-prompts.mjs --update
scripts.evals: pnpm --filter @nova/shared build && pnpm --filter @nova/evals build && varlock run -- node apps/evals/dist/cli.js
